Japan's **Anthropic Usage Index is 1.91**. That puts it **32nd of 121** countries, based on data for the period starting 2026-05-01.

The index is a country's share of Claude usage divided by its share of the world's working-age population. A value of 1.0 is the global average, so 1.91 means Japan uses Claude about 91% more than its population size alone would predict.

Some other figures, with the global average in brackets:
- **How people use it:** 47% work (43%), 47% personal (40%) and 6% coursework (16%).
- **What people ask for:** 53% of conversations get help with a task (51%), and 47% hand the task over for Claude to do (49%).
- **Most common job category:** tasks from "Computer and Mathematical" jobs make up 23% of conversations (24%).

These numbers describe observed Claude usage only. They say nothing about jobs or the labor market. Source and methodology: https://www.anthropic.com/economic-index
